note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real in Git Bash scripts via 'bash'. The AKS node bills by the hour: the last screen deletes the cluster straight after the capture.
prepare: # laptop toolchain for the bash scripts: Git Bash first on PATH, python3 and zip shims in %TEMP% (the laptop has neither)

$shim = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mgshim'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $shim | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$shim\python3", "#!/bin/bash`nexec python `"`$@`"`n"); [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$shim\zip.py", "import sys,os,zipfile`nz=zipfile.ZipFile(os.path.abspath(sys.argv[-2]),'w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)`n[z.write(os.path.join(r,n),os.path.relpath(os.path.join(r,n),'.').replace(os.sep,'/')) for r,d,f in os.walk('.') for n in f]`nz.close()`n"); [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$shim\zip", "#!/bin/bash`nexec python `"`$(dirname `"`$0`")/zip.py`" `"`$@`"`n")
az account show --query name -o none 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { az login --use-device-code }   # owner signs in as labadmin

if (-not (Get-Command kubectl -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { az aks install-cli --install-location "$env:USERPROFILE\.azure-kubectl\kubectl.exe" --kubelogin-install-location "$env:USERPROFILE\.azure-kubectl\kubelogin.exe" }
# no Docker needed: push-image.sh builds with the .NET SDK. AKS needs 4 free vCPUs of the Standard DASv5 family in West Europe (deploy-aks.sh checks and stops early)

screens.name: deploy-aca
screens.note: Shows 'phase 1', the push of 1.0.0 with the tag table, the what-if for the container app, then GET / with platform container-apps, a revision ending --v1-0-0, version 1.0.0. A slow first GET is the cold start from zero replicas (the script retries for 5 minutes).

screens.name: scale-out

steps: Optional: container app > Revisions and replicas > the replica count under load

screens.note: Left terminal (load.py) and right terminal (replicas.sh, a line every 30 s) share one window here. Expect 0 or 1, then 3 under load, then 0 about five minutes after the load ends (about 12 minutes in total: cut the wait in the edit, never fake it). If it only reaches 2 raise the workers (load.py $env:APP_URL 48 90) rather than changing the rule, and say the number reached. status must show only 200; anything else is a finding.

screens.name: revisions-split

steps: Optional: container app > Revisions and replicas with both revisions active and their weights

screens.note: The split is random: about 1.0.0 80 and 1.1.0 20, show what came out.

screens.name: aks-pods
mask: node names if they contain the group name

steps: Optional: AKS cluster > Node pools (1 node, Standard_D4as_v5) and Overview showing the Free tier, before the teardown command runs

screens.note: The AKS clock starts here (about 0.23 EUR per hour). Start the capture after the cluster step; deploy-aks.sh stops early if the DASv5 quota is below 4 vCPUs. teardown --aks-only follows immediately. Afterwards confirm az aks list -g rg-mglab-azure-08 -o table is empty.

teardown: bash infra/teardown.sh rg-mglab-azure-08 --aks-only   # no-op if already deleted
az aks list -g rg-mglab-azure-08 -o table   # empty
az group exists --name rg-mglab-azure-08   # false after a few minutes (the MC_ group goes with the cluster)
needs: quota:4 vCPU Standard DASv5 family in westeurope
